title: Totally disappointing! Waste of money!
text:
Totally disappointing! Waste of money!. I read the reviews and should have paid attention to the 6% or so that were negative. This mattress is nothing like what is described - either I got a bad one or the reviews are not real.
The mattress wobbles and moves whenever either person on the bed move - to the point of not getting proper sleep. You feel every single movement. I wonder if there is really any memory foam!
The Spring coils can be easily felt at the sides of the bed from a gentle slide of your hand along it. There is not proper covering of the coils around the sides - and no support on the sides. The mattress sinks and wobble when you get off.
It feels soft on top, but no support - just too much movement.
My back and shoulders ache even more.

So so disappointed. Dont know what I can do now with this $599 mattress- I definitely can't sleep on it. So I am back to my 6 year old mattress until I can find another.

I would NOT recommend this mattress for any type sleeper.
